verdict.rationale: Svelte is an open-source UI framework and compiler that turns components into JavaScript locally, so the vendor does not hold user data that could be opted out of AI training. A data-training opt-out is a question for hosted services, not a category of control a compiler or framework would ship. Nothing in the evidence shows Svelte collecting or retaining user data: the MCP server mention covers only documentation and code analysis, so the axis does not apply.
